Sauna Etiquette

Shower before you go in, sit on a towel, and ask the others before you throw water on the stones. Keep conversation quiet, leave your phone outside, don't eat inside, and follow the posted rules on swimwear. Shower again after. The Finnish Sauna Society sums it up as respecting other people's sauna peace.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
